_doc: Fun-metric limits and baseline for run_bot_test.py --fun-check (see fun_report.py). Medians from the 8-bot, 180 s WebSocket run on 2026-11-23 (four runs: first reward 7.4-8.5 s, rewards/min 4.2-6.2, wait 0.01 s). longest_dead_s is reported but not compared: today it is mostly bots wandering after their one gather per login (41-69 s median across runs). first_level_up_gather_s_worst (Milestone 1, 2026-11-23): every bot must reach its first level-up within 90 s of gathering, and none may gather longer than that without one. On today's 180 s run no bot levels (each gathers only 9-26 s, ~100-150 XP split over skills; level 2 needs 150 in one), so the limit only bites once bots gather more; bots_levelled_min is not set yet for the same reason.
